race.description: North East Plumbing, Roofing And Electrical Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: PEARL OF DUBAI (9) is race-fit third-up and finished third at Gosford, along with a prior Hawkesbury placing, but remains winless after nine starts. No excuses today. ON THE VERGE (5) Astern gelding from the good producing mare Snow White on debut for the O'Shea & Charlton yard. Comes here after a recent Gosford trial win over 1000m. Blinkers and lugging bit go on and can overcome the sties draw. NORTH COUNSEL (4) struck a bit of trouble at the start on debut for an even fourth at Gosford over 1200m in a Super Maiden. Improver in the small field. PINACHE (6) Pinatubo colt from a Dundeel mare on debut for the Matt Smith yard. Has shown ability in the two trials and expected to take a hand in the finish.
